verdict.rationale: Otter has a public pricing page that lists tier-gated features: free-style limits like "3 lifetime audio/video file imports", plus paid add-ons like concurrent meetings, API & Webhooks and enhanced admin features. Community reports also confirm a free user tier exists. However, the evidence shows no actual dollar prices or a clear tier-by-tier mapping, and some capabilities (Public API, data-training opt-out) sit behind Enterprise or an account manager. Missing for 10: published per-tier prices, an explicit mapping of which features belong to which tier, evidence that basic paid tiers are self-serve without sales contact, and independent corroboration of pricing transparency.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start free and see exactly what each paid tier costs and adds — no "talk to sales" wall for basic use

citations.quote: Enhanced admin features: activity logs, usage analytics, and more
